title: aotriton cmake build fails under network isolation -- pip cannot fetch dependencies
error_summary: aotriton's cmake configure creates a venv and pip-installs dependencies at configure time, but Fromager's run_network_isolation.sh blocks network access, causing pip to fail with DNS resolution errors and subsequently ModuleNotFoundError for numpy
suggested_resolution_summary: Update the aotriton Fromager plugin to pre-install filelock and numpy into the build venv before entering the network-isolated build phase, or patch aotriton's CMakeLists.txt to skip the pip invocation when packages are already available
confidence_justification: The error trace clearly shows pip retrying against PyPI inside run_network_isolation.sh (which blocks network access by design). The DNS failure pattern (Name or service not known) is the expected behavior under network isolation, not a transient infrastructure issue. The failure is deterministic and will reproduce on every retry.
